name: ElevenLabs
summary: ElevenLabs turns text into speech and can clone a voice the account is allowed to use. A business user can make a voiceover or an audio version of a written update.
paragraphs: ElevenLabs turns text into speech and can clone a voice the account is allowed to use. A business user can make a voiceover or an audio version of a written update.
whyItMatters: Use it for a voiceover of text you already wrote, and only clone a voice you have permission to use.
